config.scope: Same v1 mathematical criteria applied to prospectively fixed independent pilot16384/65536; not SBC500.
config.variance_estimator: maximum of pooled IID influence and independent replication influence
config.constants: unresolved unless integral is proved constant separately
config.evidence: complete likelihood times normalized prior over full normalized proposal
limitations: Asymptotic delta-method error, not exact finite-sample coverage.
Weight concentration and four replications cannot exclude unseen target modes.
No binomial intervals with an importance ESS substituted for sample size.
No change to historical MCMC protocol v2.
Independent levels; selection of an additional level needs a new frozen budget.
Passing this benchmark does not validate the ORF or authorize SBC500.

execution_design.note: Draw count and seeds were frozen before sampling; criteria unchanged from v1. This execution adapter records those levels before numerical results are diagnosed.
